rules: DD-041 retains exactly four top-level qualification fixtures: positive, negative, recovery, adversarial.
DD-042 retains the four semantic fixture classes, but its adversarial class contains exactly six distinct mandatory failure-mode fixture IDs required by the delegated design authority minimum set.
Base 160 cases plus this exact 13-case extension form the successor 173-case denominator.
Positive and recovery fixture PASS is mechanics-only until an independent qualification receipt exists.
A DD-042 qualification receipt must execute and pass all six mandatory adversarial fixture IDs; omission of any one is HOLD.
GitHub Actions are not execution or qualification authority.

positive.purpose: authorized payload scope is complete; every copy/key binding is accounted; retention conflicts and unverifiable erasure are zero

negative.purpose: unknown or unaccounted payload/key lineage, retention conflict, or unverifiable erasure prohibits completion

recovery.purpose: previous deletion gap is reconciled under current authority and all scope/key/retention/erasure evidence is complete

adversarial.purpose: caller-declared deletion completion or omitted replica/key evidence cannot strengthen the claim

positive.purpose: self-referential claim category is disclosed; no material self-approval loop exists; independence provenance is verified; independent adversarial evidence meets the authority-bound minimum

negative.purpose: one or more self-approval, circularity, provenance, shared-control or evidence-minimum conditions are unsafe

recovery.purpose: all self-approval/circularity/shared-control loops are removed and verified independent provenance plus adversarial evidence satisfy the minimum set

adversarial.purpose: six independently testable self-approval failure modes from the DD-042 delegated minimum adversarial authority must each fail closed
